Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 014. 字符串中的变位词

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    bool checkInclusion(string s1, string s2) {
        int m = s1.size(), n = s2.size();
        if (m > n) {
            return false;
        }
        vector<int> cnt1(26), cnt2(26);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            ++cnt1[s1[i] - 'a'];
            ++cnt2[s2[i] - 'a'];
        }
        if (cnt1 == cnt2) {
            return true;
        }
        for (int i = m; i < n; ++i) {
            ++cnt2[s2[i] - 'a'];
            --cnt2[s2[i - m] - 'a'];
            if (cnt1 == cnt2) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};
